assertions.claim: P is a represented carrier predicate and F is a total single-valued self-map P -> P via qualified schema 182001.
For every represented x in P, if F(x,y) and F(y,z), then z=x.
For every represented x in P, if F(x,y), then y is not equal to x.

explicit_nonclaims.claim: The module does not assert that P is nonempty, finite, even-cardinality, projective, geometric, topological, linear, or field-valued.
The module does not define a vector-level square-minus-one operator or any relation between vector and projective carriers.
The module does not define antipodal, quaternionic, conjugation, real-form, twistor, or source-domain semantics.
Qualification does not close W-SSC-097; a separate G7 source instance must establish the exact P/F interface.

qualification_scope: Total single-valued fixed-point-free involutions on represented carriers only.
